name: Cleveland
living: the Terminal Tower's lit crown glows and slowly breathes red and gold
the lake's water ripples, the city lights' reflections shimmering and wobbling on Lake Erie
a small boat's lights glide slowly across the lake now and then (sprite-able)
downtown windows flicker on and off across the skyline as night falls
the scoreboard's pixel crescent moon twinkles, its little stars blinking
the red neon sign on the right buzzes with a rare soft flicker
dark pixel clouds drift slowly across the lavender sky (sky layer drift), first stars twinkling
light-tower lamp banks glow and softly pulse, dust motes drifting through the cones
the red-white-blue bunting on the upper deck stirs in the lake breeze
crowd shimmer, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
